comment: Real TransferWithReferenceAndFee payments used by the evm-build.yml integration job. Each was verified on 2026-10-07 against public JSON-RPC nodes (eth_getLogs filtered on the proxy address + topic0 0x9f16cbcc523c67a60c450e5ffe4f3b7b6dbe772e7abcadb2686ce029a9a0a2b6, then eth_getTransactionReceipt: status 0x1). sepolia via ethereum-sepolia.publicnode.com; base via mainnet.base.org and 1rpc.io/base (both agreed). log_index is the event's position within the transaction receipt's logs (sepolia: block-level logIndex 54, receipt position 1; base: block-level logIndex 445, receipt position 5). source_url is the explorer page for the same transaction, given for humans; it was not itself fetched.
